simple.summary: תְּלַאשַּׂר (Tᵉlaʼssar) means Telassar , a region of Assyria First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 19 12.

definitions.full: H8515. Telassar תְּלַאשָּׂ֑ר proper name, of a location apparently in Mesopotamia ; — ׳ת 2Kin 19:12 = תְּלַשָּׂ֑ר Isa 37:12 (abode of בְּנֵיעֶֿדֶן compare As Til-ašuri (Esarhaddon) Dl Par. 264 f. ; near Edessa Wkl Geschichte. Babylonian u. Assyrian 269, 335 f.; see Schr KGF 199 f. ; identification not certain, compare Johns Ency. Bib. TELASSAR . תִּלְבּ֫שֶׁת see לבשׁ . מִּל ׳תִּלְּגַת see תִּגְלַת .
